senses.gloss: מִיהָה, מִיהֵא (v. מָחָה) to dissolve, dilute; (of clothes) to make threadbare and ragged.—Part. pass. מְהוּהֶא, f. מְהוּהָא, מְהוּהָה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:9">Toh. IX, 9</cite> <he>מטלות מהוהה</he> ed. Dehr. (oth. ed. … <he>הא</he>) a tattered (scorched) piece of cloth; <cite ref="Niddah 56a:38">Nidd. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>מטלית המהוהא</he>; <cite ref="Niddah 4a:36">ib. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>המהומה׳</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 24:17">Kel. XXIV, 17</cite> <he>מהוהה שטלייה וכ׳</he> a threadbare shred patched on a sound one (<cite ref="B01261"><he>בְּרִיָּיה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="B01239"><he>בָּרִיא</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to be tattered, fall to pieces. Ib. XXVII, 12 ed. Dehr. נמהא, Mish. ed. נמהה; Talm. ed. נמחה).

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:1">Maas. Sh. V, 1</cite> <he>מַמְהֶה ושופך</he> Ar. (ed. pr. <he>מַמְהֶא</he>; ed. <he>ממחה</he>) he dissolves (the lime) and pours it over the spot; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 69a:4">B. Kam. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ממהה</he> Ms. R. (ed. … <he>חה</he>).

<cite ref="Zevachim 54a:8">Zeb. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>מביא סיד</he> … <he>וממהא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>וממחה</he>) takes lime, molten lead and pitch and mixes them and pours &c. Ohol. XVIII, 4 <he>וממהה</he> ed. Dehr. (Ar. <he>וממהא</he>, ed. … <he>חה</he>) and crumbles (and sifts the earth).
